function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | A masterclass in psychological dread, with iconic imagery and a chilling performance by Jack Nicholson. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A disturbing family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotional trauma. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A well‑crafted haunted‑house story that balances atmosphere and jump‑scares. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight horror that turns the sunny Swedish festival into a nightmarish ritual. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Tension builds around silence; the stakes feel personal and immediate. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” trope with a relentless, creeping dread. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological horror that uses a monster as a metaphor for grief and mental illness. |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | A slow‑burn, period‑piece horror that immerses you in a claustrophobic, Puritan setting. |
|10 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror classic that still feels fresh and unsettling. |
|11 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Low‑budget, found‑footage style that makes the supernatural feel all too real. |
|12 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑commentary on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and genuine scares. |
|13 | **The Others** | 2001 | A gothic thriller with a twist that keeps you guessing until the end. |
|14 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | A timeless classic that set the standard for demonic possession films. |
|15 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | A visually stunning remake that adds a new layer of psychological horror. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, supernatural chills, or something that plays with genre expectations. Happy watching!
